reviews.review: The source supplies an in-frame counter customer for a human interaction. The frozen phrase "The customer stands across the right end of the counter, shoulders and both forearms visible" already realizes its complete relation; no distinct change is needed. Baseline/A1 retain the independently authored customer rather than attributing it to retrieval.

The full source is an adult alchemist comparing connected before/after transmutation samples in the same light, with visible process residue. A single completed glass vial appraisal is neither a paired conversion test nor an alchemist process. Extracting only the word comparison would erase its distinctive endpoints. Declined; no qualified source owner or complete transformation context was independently frozen.

The source changes subject and requires an unmistakably adult alchemist controlling a retort/crucible/vessel path plus paired states, a bounded transition and residue. The frozen generic artisan anchor supplies neither those apparatus owners nor that transformation process; no native source permission exists. Adding a robe or bottles would not preserve its meaning. Declined whole source rather than borrowing the role label.

The source connects payment approaching cashier/terminal, a supported purchased item and distinct service/customer sides. Baseline already has the cooled vial on the counter and buyer fingers setting silver onto the leather payment square. A terminal is not mandatory because the source permits a cashier position. Its generic transaction relation is already authored; no new source contribution retained.

The complete optional checkout bundle has three co-realized components: reachable payment target, item on supported checkout area, and distinguishable sides. All are already in baseline/A1 through the leather payment square, stone counter and customer across the right end. Optional member/profile IDs confer no adoption authority and are not selected. No distinct refinement owed.

This source specifically requires cafe pickup, a waiting customer, a prepared drink remaining service-side and an open handoff route. Complete A3 realizes those relations without substituting the vial for a drink. Its extra cup and second service purpose divide attention away from the appraised item and payment; A1 provides a clearer single transaction at creativity=1. Source only explored in unchosen A3, so skip.

This cafe visual profile requires an adult character and four complete owner-bound relations including a prepared drink separated from customer hands. Adult status was not requester-frozen; H-F2 grants no profile selection authority. Its ordinary visible relation is examined in full A3 using the companion source, but this profile and its gates are not adopted. The workshop-card option keeps the focal trade clearer.

Forensic inspection capture context requires forensic tags and a human owner. This fictional retail appraisal has no forensic investigation or evidence capture. A careful look at glass cannot supply that missing institutional context. Skip without claiming forensic accuracy.

Hands-only macro is a complete composition choice, not merely a closer camera. It removes the visible reference-guided face needed by the frozen reference-use direction and registered appearance gate. The final must retain identifiable people as well as hands/card/item. No viable full hands-only option preserves that reviewable appearance relationship.

The complete source is an instant physical print with image window, border, card thickness, supported contact and contact shadow. The appraisal is an in-world translucent status sheet; calling it a print would introduce a different carrier and photograph-inside-photograph relation. Those source owners were absent and are not invented to fit a matching word card. Skip.

This atomic source binds a secondary hand to the nominated small object/contact inside a portrait scope. The buyer payment fingers already contact coins and the maker hand contacts the vial with explicit wrist ownership. It contributes no new relation beyond those authored contacts; a cropped companion is not required by its selected primary clause, but no crop is introduced.

The source requires two V-shaped index-middle gestures at unequal heights and independently supported capture (tripod/timer/remote/fixed camera/photographer). No such capture support is frozen and both hand roles would displace the appraisal action. Wrist ownership alone is not this pose. Declined without inventing a source witness.

The primary clause relates the main reaction to the same visible contact/transfer. Baseline already links quiet confidence and buyer raised brows to the vial and payment. A separate reaction gesture would add no distinct information; no cropped companion relation or new expression is retained from this source.

The optional hand-contact bundle requires traceable owner, traceable object support/grip and visible contact in the same portrait. Those are already explicit in baseline and its independent embodiment review. The three optional child candidates are not selected or laundered into native chosen lists. Final A1 retains existing geometry, not a new bundle contribution.

The source is an exercise dress with continuous outer dress and visibly integrated two-legged fitted liner; it requires all five garment topology distinctions including separate-short confound control. The medium worktable scene has blouse/apron and offers no relevant dress/liner presentation. No garment relation from this full source is used.

The source connects an established adult subject, established accessory and hand toward the face; every entity outside composition effects must already exist. The vial is a crafted trade item, not an independently established worn accessory, and adult facts are not frozen. Baseline hierarchy face-vial-payment does not establish this accessory-hand-face path. Skip full source.

Raw unpolished realism can be realized within open atmosphere. Complete A3 gives soot, frayed stitching and stained stone a stronger reportage presence. Compared with A1, it makes surface wear and the cafe subplot more prominent and weakens the precise modest-item revaluation; baseline material realism is retained without the extra raw treatment. Skip unchosen A3.

Thumbnail subject clarity is compatible, but changing the whole scene to a reduced icon-like hierarchy would conceal fine text or reference appearance. A1 retains a clear maker-vial-buyer chain while reserving adequate card area. This broad source offers no distinct required mechanism beyond the existing hierarchy; its stronger object-led version is compared in A2 and not preferred.

The complete quest source requires adult pointing, quest board triangular emblem, sealed parcel matching triangle, and all pointing/matching endpoints. This appraisal has no board/parcel/seal owners or frozen adult fact. Borrowing only matching symbol as a generic HUD connector would erase its complete source. Declined; same genre alone is insufficient.

Magazine-spread negative space is a format option. Complete A3 widens the counter and reserves a clear far strip while keeping both subjects/card. Against A1 it spends image area on publication layout without a requester publication purpose, reducing the projected size of the relation evidence. Skip unchosen layout option.

I01 describes a complete generic information structure: one status sheet, an identity header above labeled attribute rows, and a separate resource block showing current/maximum. A1 retains all these parts and relations on the same item card: "LANTERN VIAL"/"UNCOMMON" header, "MIST SIGHT +12" and "VALUE 18 SILVER" rows, separate "CHARGE 6/6" block below a divider. These are independently justified generic UI attributes on open text/composition, not a distinctive qualified native cue. No native adoption/guard/owner authority is asserted. Compared with the undifferentiated baseline card, the resource and value distinctions make the displayed rule system more explicit at a modest text cost. Pixel gate B6 requires every part together. Final use is inspiration_only; causal image improvement remains unproven.

Concept object photography permits a more product-led view. Complete A2 enlarges the vial and clarifies glass thickness while keeping both humans and the system card. The ledger/page-turn adds another object and moves expression toward the background; A1 better balances object rule, maker presence and customer response. Skip unchosen A2.

This object concept product-photo treatment is the same viable open-style direction developed fully in A2. Its strong isolated material emphasis helps the vial but reduces the social force of appraisal changing payment. A1 keeps grounded material without switching to the product-led hierarchy. Skip; shared A2 comparison is specific to its product-photo meaning.

Photoreal cosplay concept is a possible style register, realized in complete A3 as a live-action costume workshop picture. The image request can be satisfied by an inhabited fictional world; emphasizing an external performance register contributes no item-rule relation and competes with craft realism. A1 is chosen on scene coherence, not a claim that cosplay is invalid.

The full historical-camera profile requires a large bellows camera on stand, seated sitter facing lens and side view across a clear gap. The capture camera is not a depicted prop in this transaction. Introducing a portrait sitting would replace the selected moment or add a subplot; no bellows-era authenticity is inferred. Skip full profile.

Two adult craftspeople supporting a panel and passing a tool require the primary character_pose_proxemics_scene_atomic_scene context. Neither that native context nor a panel/tool-pass owner relation is frozen. A customer paying for a vial is not the source shared load-bearing task. Declined rather than treating ordinary working distance as its full meaning.

The source binds asymmetric brow tension, head direction and paused hand to one judged sample, with primary character_face_gaze_impression_scene_atomic_scene context. That native prerequisite is absent. Baseline raised brows are an authored response and not proof of this qualified expression scene; no extra paused-hand instruction is imported.

The source sets an established role-signaling object aside while both adult hands are free, with all actors/objects already established outside effects. No role-play-ending object or adult witness is independently frozen. The crafted vial is for sale, not a role-play token. Its optional erotic reading is not inferred from material or profession; skip full relation.

A glassblowing hot shop setting is already authored through copper rod, shears, cooling rack and warm rear furnace. The transaction deliberately occurs on the cold counter within that shop. Its complete setting contributes no distinct final change, so skip rather than claiming retrieval created the workshop.

The page-turn source requires pinch of one corner, sheet bending away, root still attached to book and coherent wrist/thickness. Complete A2 realizes every endpoint on a bound workshop ledger, replacing the left-hand vial support. This is physically compatible but introduces a secondary reading task beside an already readable system card. A1 keeps a direct maker-item contact and fewer competing labels; skip unchosen A2.

Interlaced own fingers are a viable optional pose with separable wrists, but not a substitute for merely touching fingertips. A2 can alternatively place the maker hands interlaced behind the free-standing product; this would remove her direct tactile appraisal relationship. A2 is fully developed as a product-and-ledger option, with this pose version separately specified below. A1 retains the supported vial contact for stronger craft relevance.

Thin-air-gap Newton fringes require an already selected shallow convex lens resting on a flat glass plate and fringes on that shared interface. A curved vial on opaque stone is a different carrier. The material/color-only effects cannot create the missing lens/plate apparatus or transfer fringes to the white seed. Skip complete source.
